# MaterialsHub

> Materials intelligence platform for the building-materials trade: product/material search across supplier catalogs, AI interior design and visualisation, quotes and orders, and a hiring/careers surface. This file maps the parts of the platform that are PUBLIC and useful to an AI agent or crawler. Everything else requires an authenticated session.

Most of the platform is behind login. The public surfaces below are safe to read, link to, and integrate with. Where a machine-readable API exists we list it in preference to the HTML page.

## Public APIs

- [Job board API (JSON)](https://bgbavxtjlbvgplozizxu.supabase.co/functions/v1/hr-careers?slug=COMPANY_SLUG): Open job postings for one company. Anonymous, no API key. `GET ?slug=<company-slug>` returns `{ company, count, jobs[] }`; add `&job=<job-slug>` for one posting with its full description and requirements. Each job carries `absolute_url` and `updated_at`. Cached 5 minutes. Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby-style — intended for aggregators, partner sites and scripts.
- [Edge Functions OpenAPI spec](https://app.materialshub.gr/api/openapi-edge.json): OpenAPI 3.0.3 description of the platform's Supabase Edge Function surface (96 functions). Most require authentication; the spec marks which are public.
- [Swagger UI](https://app.materialshub.gr/api/edge-swagger.html): Browsable version of the spec above.

## Public pages

- [Careers page](https://app.materialshub.gr/careers/COMPANY_SLUG): A company's public job listings. Individual postings live at `/careers/{company-slug}/{job-slug}` and emit schema.org `JobPosting` JSON-LD, so job search engines can index them directly.
- [Knowledge base](https://app.materialshub.gr/knowledge-base): Published articles on materials, specification and application. Individual articles at `/knowledge-base/{slug}`.
- [Documentation](https://app.materialshub.gr/documentation/): Product and API documentation.
- [Free tools](https://app.materialshub.gr/tools): Public utilities — price scan, mention scan, project-plan estimator, heat-pump sizer, heating-cost comparison.

## Notes for agents

- Company slugs are per-workspace and are not enumerable; substitute a real slug you already have (the same slug appears in that company's careers URL).
- A job posting is public only while its status is open AND it is not past its close date. Closed postings return 404 from the API and disappear from the board.
- Share links of the form `/q/{token}`, `/cv/{token}`, `/sign/{token}`, `/i/{token}` and `/sheets/share/{token}` are private, single-purpose links. Do not crawl, index or share them.
- **Crawl policy, stated once so it cannot contradict itself.** `robots.txt` allows the answer-engine and search agents — `OAI-SearchBot`, `ChatGPT-User`, `Claude-SearchBot`, `Claude-User`, `PerplexityBot`, `Perplexity-User`, `meta-externalfetcher`, plus Googlebot and Bingbot — to read every public surface listed above. It blocks the training crawlers (`GPTBot`, `ClaudeBot`, `CCBot`, `Google-Extended`, `Applebot-Extended`, `Bytespider`, `meta-externalagent`, ...). Retrieving this content to answer someone's question is welcome; adding it to a training corpus is not. Both files express that one policy — if they ever disagree, `robots.txt` is the one machines obey.
- Applications cannot be submitted through the job board API; it is read-only.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://app.materialshub.gr/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of public pages.
- [robots.txt](https://app.materialshub.gr/robots.txt): Crawl policy.
